name: Nanobots
description: Injects nanobots into this unit or an ally within %cast_range% tile, cleansing and healing %heal% health immediately and again at the start of each of their turns for %duration% turns.
details: Only debuffs that can be cleansed are stripped.

upgrade.summary: The bots stay dormant afterwards to strip one more debuff.
details: Only debuffs that can be cleansed are stripped.
When the %duration% turns of healing are up the bots stay in the body rather than dissolving, waiting.
The next cleansable debuff the host receives is stripped on arrival, and the bots burn out doing it. They heal nothing while they wait.
